objective: Certificar en solo lectura el contrato fisico de dbo.RH_Cat_Puestos y auditar si el modelo canonico de Producto ya soporta talla/color/variantes suficientes para Uniformes. No modificar datos, esquema, codigo, frontend ni Produccion. El objetivo es evitar crear RH_Uniforme_Tallas o atributos paralelos si Producto ya los resuelve.

queries.name: rh_puestos_columns
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,t.name AS table_name,c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,ty.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.precision,c.scale,c.is_nullable,c.is_identity FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE s.name='dbo' AND t.name='RH_Cat_Puestos' ORDER BY c.column_id

queries.name: rh_puestos_pk_fk
queries.sql: SELECT 'PK' AS relation_type,OBJECT_NAME(kc.parent_object_id) AS table_name,c.name AS column_name,ty.name AS data_type,kc.name AS constraint_name,NULL AS referenced_table,NULL AS referenced_column FROM sys.key_constraints kc JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id=kc.parent_object_id AND ic.index_id=kc.unique_index_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=ic.object_id AND c.column_id=ic.column_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE kc.type='PK' AND OBJECT_NAME(kc.parent_object_id)='RH_Cat_Puestos' UNION ALL SELECT 'FK',OBJECT_NAME(fk.parent_object_id),pc.name,pty.name,fk.name,OBJECT_NAME(fk.referenced_object_id),rc.name FROM sys.foreign_keys fk JOIN sys.foreign_key_columns fkc ON fkc.constraint_object_id=fk.object_id JOIN sys.columns pc ON pc.object_id=fkc.parent_object_id AND pc.column_id=fkc.parent_column_id JOIN sys.types pty ON pty.user_type_id=pc.user_type_id JOIN sys.columns rc ON rc.object_id=fkc.referenced_object_id AND rc.column_id=fkc.referenced_column_id WHERE OBJECT_NAME(fk.parent_object_id)='RH_Cat_Puestos'

queries.name: producto_variant_candidate_tables
queries.sql: SELECT t.name AS table_name,COUNT(*) AS column_count FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id WHERE s.name='dbo' AND (t.name LIKE 'Producto%' OR t.name LIKE '%Variante%' OR t.name LIKE '%Atributo%' OR t.name LIKE '%Talla%' OR t.name LIKE '%Color%') GROUP BY t.name ORDER BY t.name

queries.name: producto_variant_candidate_columns
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 300 t.name AS table_name,c.name AS column_name,ty.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.is_nullable FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE s.name='dbo' AND (t.name LIKE 'Producto%' OR t.name LIKE '%Variante%' OR t.name LIKE '%Atributo%' OR t.name LIKE '%Talla%' OR t.name LIKE '%Color%' OR c.name LIKE '%Talla%' OR c.name LIKE '%Color%' OR c.name LIKE '%Variante%' OR c.name LIKE '%Atributo%') ORDER BY t.name,c.column_id
